name: Dagon
summary: Dagon, the Fish-God of ancient Philistine legend, is invoked by the narrator when questioning a celebrated ethnologist, hinting obliquely at the identity of the monstrous entity he witnessed.
description: Dagon is referenced only briefly, as the subject of an ancient Philistine legend the narrator raised with a celebrated ethnologist, who identified him as 'the Fish-God.' No further details of Dagon's nature or history are given in the account.

sources.quote: the ancient Philistine legend of Dagon, the Fish-God
